text:
His name is Antonio,

as he might be named

Agüero,

Mariano Roque Alonso,

Alberto Candia,

Alonso Ramírez,

Juan Carlos Rivas,

Juan Mora,

Mariano Jara,

Miguel Ángel Soler,

Derlis Villagra,

Rubén González Acosta,

Emio Roa and so many,

so many! others.

But his name is Antonio,

unique Antonio

of the thick wall

of the dark cell

that could not defeat him

in 20 years

of "pantheons for the living"

in the 3rd Police Station,

in the camp of "Emboscada."

His name is

and will forever be called

Antonio Maidana,

Antonio whole,

Antonio Quebracho,

as the people call him,

who receive his example

in the night

of struggle

and waiting.

The only Antonio named

when one says light, quebracho, strength.

translation.title: Antonio Maidana
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the roll call of political prisoners and Antonio Maidana's symbolic name as light, quebracho, and strength.
